messages.subject: 500 error deleting application
parts:
I tried to delete an app and failed with a 500 error. Specifically, I appeared to be successful archiving the app -- it's current status in the dashboard is archived -- but when I try to delete it, I get the following error message:

Waiting for task: 241648369
  purge-bundles: Deleting bundles
  cleanup: Cleaning up...
Error: Unhandled Exception: HTTP 500: Internal Server Error

I can't restore or run the app either -- I get an error message about a missing bundle when I try. Best guess is that it has been deleted in the functional sense but its ghost lives on in my dashboard. Anyone know a way to purge the dash entry?

Thanks,
Paul
